Project Monitoring & Implementation Support Oversee implementation phases including final evaluation and follow-up; offer hands-on support to ensure successful use of funds to receive the desired outcomes. Sustainability Leadership Apply and monitor EIB standards across Climate, Environmental, Social, and Procurement dimensions to uphold best-in-class governance and full alignment with the Bank's standards. Technical Assistance Provide guidance and support to project promoters through tailored technical assistance. Teamwide Support Support other divisions in evaluating and delivering projects that feature health components. Strategic Contribution Participate in other key sector initiatives and priority activities identified by the Bank, Directorate, Department, or Division. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with the Bank’s Operational and Global Directorates and to identify investment opportunities aligned with country-specific priorities and strategic goals. Policy & Sector Development Contribute to the Bank's sector policies by drafting and developing policy, methodologies, and sector-specific papers within your area of expertise. Insightful Sector Updates Produce regular briefings and sector updates to inform internal stakeholders and guide strategic planning and policy shaping. Continuous Learning Stay on top of emerging trends, best practices, and legislative changes—sharing key insights with colleagues across the organization. Qualifications University degree (minimum an equivalent to a Bachelor) in medical, economic, technical or similar fields; a post-graduate degree at Master’s level or equivalent in health economics, health management, health engineering, public health, or another equivalent specialisation relevant for the health sector would be an asset; Minimum of 5 years (ideally 8 - 12years) of relevant professional experience in the health sector covering the main aspects of the standard project cycle (feasibility, design, implementation/development, management and operation) and in particular in relation to large-scale health projects and programs in at least three countries, including low and medium income countries Very good knowledge of the health sector policies, organization and functioning, including the global and EU policies and current trends, with particular focus on health systems organization and financing, Sustainable Development Goals and economics of health investments (economic rate of return, financial rate of return, NPV, etc.) Professional experience in providing advisory services / technical assistance gained with a consultancy, corporate, research institute or financial institution; Excellent writing skills and ability to conceptualise and draft specific sharp reports, sector studies, papers and policy briefings for a wider audience; Excellent knowledge of English. Advantage Professional experience working for or in Low- and Middle-Income Countries health sectors could be considered as advantage; Knowledge of other EU languages would be a distinct advantage. Competencies Find Out More About EIB Core Behavioural Skills Here To find out more about our eligibility criteria click here (***) Unless stated explicitly as a required qualification, a good command of French is not a pre-requisite for hire. Any language clause in your contract must be fulfilled in order for you to be eligible for a promotion (either via the annual appraisal cycle or via an internal selection process). If you require reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process due to a disability, neurodivergence, or a chronic health condition, please contact the EIB Recruitment team Jobs@eib.org who will manage your request appropriately. By applying for this position, you acknowledge the importance of maintaining the security and integrity of the Information of the EIB Group. In case of selection for the position you agree to comply with all measures (policies, controls, document classification and management) implemented by the EIB Group to prevent unauthorised disclosure of any information or any damage to the EIB Group reputation. This is an open campaign to consecutively fill open positions. The campaign will remain open until position is filled. Applications will be reviewed in order of receipt. If you are interested in the position, we encourage you to apply early, as initial decisions are typically made within the first three weeks of the campaign.
